## Experience

- Software Development Senior Specialist, NTT DATA (2015 – present): design and development of Java / J2EE / Spring web applications for enterprise Finance clients; uses GitHub Copilot and other AI tools in the delivery workflow.
- Senior Software Engineer, CGI (2010 – 2015): Java / J2EE web applications for clients in the Energy and Telecom domains (JSF, Hibernate, Oracle DB).

## Projects

- [Wells Fargo public site](https://www.wellsfargo.com): public-facing banking and financial-services web platform (Finance).
- [DCC — Instant Energy](https://www.smartdcc.co.uk): smart-meter subsystem implementing primary metering functions (Energy).
- [OBE Web Tool](https://support.bell.ca/Billing-and-Accounts/Billing): online billing-presentation application for Bell Canada (Telecom).
- [Prodis Entry Exit, phases 2 and 3](https://www.bordgaisenergy.ie): gas-transportation shipper-management system for Bord Gáis Energy (Energy).
